schema_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS Communication (id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY, comm_action NVARCHAR(255), comm_channelid INT, payload NVARCHAR(MAX))
generation_sql: INSERT INTO Communication (comm_action, comm_channelid, payload) SELECT TOP ({row_count}) 'Action_' + CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS NVARCHAR), ABS(CHECKSUM(NEWID()) % 100), REPLICATE('X', 100) FROM sys.all_objects a CROSS JOIN sys.all_objects b

tables.name: Communication
tables.purpose: Primary table to simulate insert performance and blocking behavior.
tables.distribution_notes: Uniform distribution for comm_channelid with a large payload size.
